  "text": "## 4. Capabilities\n\nA capability is the authority to use an effect over a scope. A program\ncannot create authority. The rules:\n\n| Rule | Says |\n|---|---|\n| C1 | Every effect a workflow body or skill uses is covered by a capability in scope |\n| C2 | A delegate gets the agent's capabilities that lie inside the context's (`A.caps ∩ avail(ctx)`). `with caps K` replaces the kinds it names, and K must lie inside both |\n| C3 | `c.narrow(…)` is always inside `c`; nothing widens a capability |\n| C4 | A workflow's `caps` are the upper bound of what its entry point may be granted |\n| C5 | The write capabilities (`fs.write`, `git.*`) of different `par` branches do not overlap |\n\nAn unused capability is reported: the sandbox it produces bounds real\nuse from above.\n"
}"}],"structuredContent":{"text":"## 4. Capabilities

A capability is the authority to use an effect over a scope. A program
cannot create authority. Capabilities are granted at the entry point,
passed explicitly, and can only shrink.

| Constructor | Authorizes | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| `fs.read(P…)`, `fs.write(P…)` | `Fs.Read`, `Fs.Write` | Paths, compared by segment after resolving `.` and `..` |
| `net.https(hosts: […], methods: […])` | `Net` | Hosts, and from 0.5 the methods each allows ([`boundary.md`](boundary.md#language-05)) |
| `model.infer(tier: t, max_class: c)` | `Model` | A model tier and the highest data class |
| `exec(commands: […], args_prefix: […])` | `Exec` | Commands and their argument prefixes |
| `git.pr(repo)` | `git.*` | Repositories |
| `money.spend(…)` | `Spend` | — |
| `component.read(c…)`, `component.write(c, p…)` | `Fs.Read`, `Fs.Write` | The components' roots, or paths inside them |
| `component.exec(c, build \| test)` | `Exec` | The commands the component declares |
| `component.repo(c…)` | `git.*` | The components' repositories |
| `data.read(env, r…)` | `Data.Read` | Declared reads of an environment |
| `env.deploy(e…)`, `env.migrate(e…)` | `deploy`, `migrate` | Environments |

`Human`, `Time`, `Random` and `Delegate` need no capability. The rules:

| Rule | Says |
|---|---|
| C1 | Every effect a workflow body or skill uses is covered by a capability in scope |
| C2 | A delegate gets the agent's capabilities that lie inside the context's (`A.caps ∩ avail(ctx)`). `with caps K` replaces the kinds it names, and K must lie inside both |
| C3 | `c.narrow(…)` is always inside `c`; nothing widens a capability |
| C4 | A workflow's `caps` are the upper bound of what its entry point may be granted |
| C5 | The write capabilities (`fs.write`, `git.*`) of different `par` branches do not overlap |

An unused capability is reported: the sandbox it produces bounds real
use from above.
